proposed.text: How may time-dependent deflection be treated when nonstructural elements are attached after some deflection has already occurred?

options.text: All prior deflection must be doubled.
The time-dependent deflection may be reduced by the amount calculated to occur before attachment.

rationale.correct: The Table 424.2.2 note permits reducing time-dependent deflection by the amount calculated to occur before nonstructural elements are attached.
rationale.a: Not selected: All prior deflection must be doubled.
rationale.b: Not selected: The time-dependent deflection may be reduced by the amount calculated to occur before attachment.
rationale.c: Not selected: Attachment timing never matters.
rationale.d: Not selected: The member automatically becomes nonstructural.
rationale.takeaway: The Table 424.2.2 note permits reducing time-dependent deflection by the amount calculated to occur before nonstructural elements are attached.
